role: ADR 005: explains why an unowned back-pointer from a helper to its owner traps on async paths and records the decision that helpers are structs holding owners strongly, with a gate banning unowned.

units.key: § 005 — Helpers hold their owner strongly; `unowned` is banned
§ 005 — Helpers hold their owner strongly; `unowned` is banned > Context
units.does: Context: helper types beside their owners (collector coordinators, HealthKit query groups, workout ticker/finalizer, PDF renderers, archive store and migrations, cloud pull/deletion, assistant router/tool runner) with an unowned let back-pointer trap when a Task or resumed continuation outlives the owner; a launch-time migration started in the collector's initialiser is enough to hit it, and fixing only the reported sites leaves the rest. Matches scripts/check_no_unowned.sh; no unowned let/var remains in Emuqu/Sources or the watch app (only comments mention it).

units.key: § 005 — Helpers hold their owner strongly; `unowned` is banned > Decision
units.does: Claims helpers are structs built on demand by owners (collector.control, manager.writes, recorder.ticker), stored callbacks capture the owner weakly (a weak capture no-ops once the owner is gone), fire-and-forget tasks capture strongly, and check_no_unowned.sh fails on any unowned with verify_gates_fail.sh proving it. Verified: RRCollector.control (RRCollector.swift), HealthKitManager.writes (HealthKitManager.swift), WorkoutRecorder.ticker (WorkoutRecorder+TickerForwarding.swift) are computed builders; check_no_unowned.sh greps every unowned / unowned(safe|unsafe) spelling (stored and capture list) in Emuqu/Sources and EmuquWatch Watch App; verify_gates_fail.sh plants one.

units.key: § 005 — Helpers hold their owner strongly; `unowned` is banned > Consequences
units.does: Claims the bug class is removed, helpers are stateless values in which the compiler rejects [weak self] so every capture is decided explicitly, and weak remains for optional back-references, citing WorkoutVoiceCoach, BeatConsistencyPriorsCache, TrainingMetricsCache. Verified: WorkoutVoiceCoach.swift/41 weak watchBridge/conversation, BeatConsistencyPriorsCache.swift weak boundArchive, TrainingMetricsCache.swift weak healthKit.
